summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.total: sums the tenant's approved entries (refunds included) and rounds to 2 dp with MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero per RQ-FXL-0003 / DF-FXL-0007. Banker's rounding (RQ-FXL-0103, superseded) not used.

criteria.criterion: Unapproved entries and other tenants' entries do not count
criteria.test: unapproved entries and other tenants' entries do not count

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.approve following the ordered checks in RQ-FXL-0004: SessionExpired via fx-identity isActive, NotAuthorized if no Approver role (flat roles), NotFound for an entry outside the session's tenant or missing, then the RQ-FXL-0104 amendment (amount > 10,000 needs Approver and Admin, NotAuthorized), SelfApproval, AlreadyApproved. On success sets Approved and ApprovedBy only. Tests cover every acceptance criterion of RQ-FXL-0004 and RQ-FXL-0104 that is in the package scope.

criteria.criterion: A session idle for exactly 15 minutes can approve
criteria.test: a session idle for exactly 15 minutes can approve

criteria.criterion: At 15 minutes 1 second the session gets SessionExpired
criteria.test: a session idle for 15 minutes and 1 second gets SessionExpired

criteria.criterion: An Admin without Approver gets NotAuthorized
criteria.test: an Admin without Approver gets NotAuthorized

criteria.criterion: (RQ-FXL-0104) An Approver without Admin approving an entry of 10,000.01 gets NotAuthorized
criteria.test: an Approver without Admin approving 10000.01 gets NotAuthorized

criteria.criterion: (RQ-FXL-0104) An entry of exactly 10,000 needs only Approver
criteria.test: an entry of exactly 10000 needs only Approver

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.view: returns SessionExpired when fx-identity isActive is false, otherwise the entries whose TenantId equals the session's tenant, in original order, with no role widening (RQ-FXL-0006, DF-FXL-0005). Note: the fx-ledger README states administrators can view all tenants; that conflicts with the accepted DF-FXL-0005 and was not followed. The README was not changed.

criteria.criterion: An Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries
criteria.test: an Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries

summary: Not implemented; convertCurrency remains a stub. The package status is INCOMPLETE: RQ-FXL-0008 is proposed (not authoritative), DF-FXL-0009 (choice of exchange-rate source) is draft and undecided, and RQ-FXL-0008 has no acceptance criteria.
